audit.recode_to: Chajul Ixil lexical stress = quantity-INSENSITIVE syllabic trochees (Adell 2019 sec. 2.5.2): Stress System A (most speakers, 'the primary system'): left-to-right trochees, primary stress on the root-initial syllable of the metrical word (Set A prefixes extrametrical), secondary on alternate syllables to the right; Stress System B (minority, older men; per Adell also the Nebaj lexical system): right-to-left trochees, primary stress on the penult. kind -> not 'weight' (root-initial/left edge for System A ~ penult for System B; wcls none); the CVV-final 'final stress' of Ayres 1991 rules 2/4/7 is Adell's declarative BOUNDARY TONE (H on the penultimate mora of the intonational phrase, long V bimoraic, CVC/CV'C monomoraic), domain PHRASE, which overrides lexical stress in phrase-final = citation forms. At minimum add Adell 2019 to 'contra' with a caution and let the editor rule between (a) recode to quantity-insensitive trochaic (initial~penult by speaker) with the mora-counting boundary tone noted as phrasal, or (b) keep Ayres's surface citation-form generalisation but re-label domain PHRASE and evidence as contested. Nebaj srule (Ayres: any final C -> final stress) is also contradicted by Adell's aside (Nebaj = System B penult) and should carry a caution.
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding quotation, the domain quote and the exceptions quote are all present verbatim in the held scanned text of Ayres 1991 at sec. 1-4A/1-4B, printed pp. 8-10, exactly as the locator says. (2) Deciding source: a 1991 reference grammar by the language's principal academic describer, with an explicit dialect-split stress section; the coding (weight-sensitive, right edge, Chajul: final long vowel or final CC cluster -> final stress, final short V or VC -> penult, V'C variable by speaker; Nebaj: any final C or long V -> final, final short V -> penult; listed loanword exceptions; phrase-level single accent) is a faithful reading of rules 1-7 and 1-4. The held 2023 ALMG normative grammar reproduces the same table and cites Ayres 1991:8-10, so it adds no independent evidence but shows nothing in the community standard contradicts it. (3) Not the best available: Glottolog lis
